title: Mental Health Basics
summary: Mental health is emotional, psychological and social wellbeing. Anxiety involves persistent worry; depression involves lasting low mood or loss of interest. Both are common and treatable.
answer_guidance: Be warm and non-clinical. If the user mentions self-harm or suicidal thoughts, prioritise safety and encourage contacting local emergency services or a helpline (India: Tele-MANAS 14416).
